review.notes: Claims were checked against the linked primary or regulatory source. Evidence and causality are stated conservatively; independent human review is encouraged.

objective: Grow qualified organic discovery for a Korean employment platform.
businessContext: The platform had crawl errors, duplicate content and opportunities to clarify job content for search engines.
strategy: Treat SEO as a sustained product and engineering program rather than a one-time keyword exercise.
outcomes: Google reports 102% year-over-year organic traffic growth in the September 2019 hiring season, 93% growth in new sign-ups from organic traffic and a 9% year-over-year conversion-rate increase.
whatWorked: Technical fixes and structured data were connected to an explicit conversion outcome.
The program accumulated improvements over several years.
whatFailed: Seasonality and concurrent changes are not controlled in the published case study.
transferConditions: A large structured-content marketplace can measure both search visibility and downstream conversion.
nonTransferConditions: Do not generalize the reported magnitude to sites with different demand, authority or inventory.

sources.title: Saramin SEO investment case study
sources.methodology: Platform case study reports implementation and year-over-year outcomes; no controlled counterfactual is described.
